title: Chinese fraud victims challenge UK redress plan for 61,000 seized Bitcoin: FT
summary: Chinese investors defrauded in the Zhimin Qian case are asking the UK High Court to reject a redress plan for 61,000 seized Bitcoin, saying it could deprive them of the assets’ gains.

title: Bitcoin buyers ‘in control’ but trend won't change until this level breaks
summary: Bitcoin analysts said buyers were regaining control, but reclaiming $78,000 as support was key to reversing the overall downtrend.

title: JPMorgan sued over alleged role in $328M crypto Ponzi scheme
summary: Investors allege JPMorgan helped facilitate fund flows in a $328 million crypto Ponzi scheme, while a parallel federal case targets Goliath Ventures’ founder.

title: Utah set to block prediction markets as state-federal tensions rise
summary: CFTC Chair Michael Selig has said that the agency has authority over prediction markets like Kalshi and Polymarket and warned it will defend that jurisdiction in court if challenged.

title: US prosecutors urge judge to deny Sam Bankman-Fried retrial bid: Report
summary: Prosecutors say testimony from two former FTX executives cited by the defense does not qualify as newly discovered evidence, Bloomberg reported.

title: Bonk.fun warns hackers hijacked domain in wallet-drainer attack
summary: Bonk.fun warned users not to use its site after attackers hijacked the domain and pushed a fake wallet-draining prompt.

title: New Zealand regulator says NZDD stablecoin not a financial product
summary: Law firm MinterEllisonRuddWatts, which acted on behalf of the stablecoin’s issuer, says the designation of the token is an important step for regulatory clarity.

title: AI agent payment volumes lower than reported, but adoption is growing: a16z
summary: Andreessen Horowitz partner Noah Levine says AI agents made $1.6 million in payments in the past month, which “is not a big number, but the infrastructure being built around it is.”

title: Kalshi preemptively sues Iowa, claiming risk of enforcement action
summary: Kalshi claims in a preemptive lawsuit that there is “a substantial risk” that Iowa will take action against it after a meeting it had with state regulators.

title: Stablecoin yields will bring fresh money to US banks: White House's Witt
summary: Global demand for the US dollar is “massive,” and stablecoin yields will only bring more interest to the currency, argued the White House crypto chief.
